title: MICA v0.2.7 Archive DI Binding Extension
description: Patch schema governing the binding property on design_invariants entries in MICA archive JSON. Supersedes mica-v0.2.4-archive-di-binding.schema.json. v0.2.7 change: DI id pattern extended from ^DI-\d+$ to ^(DI|INV)(-[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*)?-\d+$ to support domain-namespaced IDs (e.g. DI-EQA-001, DI-BIO-001) and grandfathered INV-xxx prefixes. Uses allOf composition to extend the base entry, preserving backward compatibility.

diBinding.description: Evidence block linking a design invariant to the episode that created it.

origin_episode.description: Human-readable description of the event that motivated this invariant. Must name the specific incident, not just describe the rule.

violation_count.description: Number of recorded violations. Updated manually when a new violation is logged.

lesson_ref.description: Relative path from project root to a lesson file. Validated by PCT-011 for file existence. A dead link is a binding integrity failure.

last_triggered.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent known violation.

designInvariantEntryV027.description: Extends designInvariantEntry with optional binding. v0.2.7: id pattern allows DI-[DOMAIN]-NNN and INV-NNN in addition to canonical DI-NNN. additionalProperties intentionally NOT applied at combined level so legacy fields pass without modification.

id.description: Design invariant identifier. Canonical: DI-NNN. Domain-namespaced: DI-[DOMAIN]-NNN (e.g. DI-EQA-001). Grandfathered: INV-NNN. Must be unique within the archive.

statement.description: Full rule text. Describe what must not happen, precisely.

rationale.description: Legacy prose field from pre-binding archives. Superseded by binding.origin_episode for new entries.

track.description: Track ID this DI applies to. Absent means all tracks.

design_invariants.description: Array of design invariant entries. Each entry must satisfy designInvariantEntryV027.

$comment: PCT-010 checks binding.origin_episode on archive design_invariants[severity==critical]. PCT-011 checks binding.lesson_ref path existence. Namespace modes: sequential (DI-NNN), domain_namespaced (DI-[DOM]-NNN), legacy_inv (INV-NNN). Governed by mica.yaml di_policy.namespace_mode.
